"''Pragmatic. They were charging us protection. We have to protect our margins.|Cad Bane and the boss|{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}}}} The '''Pyke Boss''' was a [[Pyke]] [[Gender|male]] who led the [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s operations on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] and, by [[9 ABY]], controlled the entire syndicate. After the operations came into [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|conflict]] with the local [[Tusken Raider]]s around [[5 ABY]], a protection fee was demanded for the indigenous people, which the boss's superiors refused as they already paid the [[Nikto]] [[Speeder bike|bikers]] of the [[Kintan Striders Gang]]. The Pyke boss discussed the arrangement complications with the ex-[[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]], the Tuskens' representative, who promised that the Pykes would not hear from the Nikto bikers again. Having lied to Fett, the boss had the Tusken tribe destroyed and framed the Kintan Striders, which Fett took revenge on. The former [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] later became the [[Daimyo]] of Tatooine, but was defied by [[Mayor of Mos Espa|Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]] of the [[city]] [[Mos Espa]], who promised the Daimyo's territories to the Pyke Syndicate. The boss thus prepared to usurp Fett, sending the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]] to keep the settlement [[Freetown]] from joining the Daimyo and having his own assets [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|bomb]] the [[Sanctuary]] [[cantina]] in Mos Espa. Working with the leaders of Mos Espa's three families, the boss staged an [[Battle of Mos Espa|attack]] on the [[Fett gotra]] in Mos Espa. However, the forces failed to defeat the [[gotra]] and retreated back to the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] where the boss was based. The Pyke informed the leaders of Mos Espa that he was leaving Tatooine, much to their displeasure, when they were interrupted by an [[Assassination of the Pyke Syndicate leaders|attack]]. With his allies being shot down, the boss fired back and attempted to face the attacker, [[Fennec Shand]]. However, Shand stabbed him in the back. ==Biography== ===Conflict with locals=== {{Quote|I've spoken to my superiors on Oba Diah and they are unwilling to pay protection to more than one party.|The Pyke boss, to Boba Fett|}} The [[Gender|male]] [[Pyke]] was a member of the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. Around [[5 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the flashback events of "[[Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa]]" to around [[5 ABY]]. he was the boss of the Pyke's [[spice]] trading operations on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], operating from the [[Desert Survey Office]] in the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]]. During his spice operations, the boss paid protection fees to the [[Kintan Striders Gang]], a local [[Nikto]] [[Speeder bike|biker]] gang, to pass through Tatooine's [[Dune Sea]]. However, when their [[transport]]ation of [[sansanna spice]] came into [[Skirmish in the Dune Sea|conflict]] with the [[Tusken Raider]]s, the indigenous people of the Dune Sea, a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of Tuskens [[Raid on a Pyke repulsortrain|attacked]] a Pyke [[Tatooine repulsor train|repulsor train]]. The train was caused to crash, and the surviving Pykes were sent back to the boss with a message to pay a toll for the Tuskens.{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}} [[File:Boba-Pyke-meeting.png|thumb|right|300px|The Pyke boss speaks with Boba Fett]] In response to the Tusken retaliation, the boss spoke with his superiors in the Pyke Syndicate, who refused to pay protection fees to multiple parties, wishing not to be taken advantage of. Soon enough, [[Boba Fett]], a former [[bounty hunter]] who was representing the Tuskens, traveled to Mos Eisley to visit the Pyke boss and collect protection fees. The boss informed Fett of his superiors' refusal to make double arrangements and their existing deal with the [[Kintan]] Striders. The Pyke claimed he was willing to pay either party, but not both, and so Fett promised the Pykes would not hear from the Nikto bikers again. As the ex-[[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] turned to leave, the boss stated that he looked forward to their partnership. However, the boss had lied to Fett, and sent his forces to [[Massacre of a Tusken Raider tribe|massacre]] the Tusken Raider tribe. The Pykes left the symbol of the Kintan Striders behind to frame the biker gang.{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} When Fett found tribe destroyed, he recognized the symbol and fell for the syndicate's ploy, later [[Attack on the Kintan Striders|obliterating]] the Nikto bikers{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} in [[9 ABY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' in what he thought was revenge. After, Fett changed his focus went on to murder [[Bib Fortuna]], the [[Daimyo]] of the Tatooine territories, seizing the position for himself and starting his own [[gotra]], the [[Fett gotra]]. Fett's newly established rule was met with resistance from multiple figures, including [[Mayor of Mos Espa|Mayor]] [[Mok Shaiz]] of the [[city]] [[Mos Espa]], who chose to promise Fett's territories to the Pyke Syndicate. By that time, the Pyke Boss had control over the entire Pyke Syndicate.{{Databank|pyke-boss|Pyke Boss}} ===Tatooine takeover=== {{Quote|You returned so quickly. Was your venture successful?''"
"''You won't have to worry about Freetown.|The boss and Cad Bane|}} With Pyke troops gathering in Mos Espa, Mok Shaiz took refuge in the Desert Survey Office with the boss. The Pyke chose to begin his [[War against the Pykes|takeover]] of Fett's territories by [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|bombing]] the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]] [[cantina]]. He also sent the [[Duros]] bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]] to the settlement [[Freetown]], where Fett's [[Mandalorian]] ally [[Din Djarin]] had reached out to [[Marshal]] [[Cobb Vanth]] to help the Daimyo, to make sure the people there would not interfere with the Pykes. The Duros gunned down Vanth as a message to the residents of Freetown to stay neutral.{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}} [[File:Boba7-PykePragmatic.png|thumb|left|300px|The Pyke Boss explains the syndicate's decision to destroy Boba Fett's Tusken tribe.]] When Bane returned to the Desert Survey Office, the Pyke boss, breaking from his conversation with Shaiz, commended how quick the bounty hunter had been. After Bane confirmed that Vanth would be staying neutral in the war against Fett, Shaiz questioned if there was any other assets Fett had, mentioning his old Tusken tribe. The boss explained to the mayor that the Pykes had dealt with the tribe themselves and framed the Kintan Striders. Shaiz asked when the Pyke Syndicate's war with Fett would be over and expressed displeasure with the bombing of the Sanctuary as he had not signed up for open warfare. The boss apologized for crossing the line with his deal with the mayor and revealed his intelligence that Fett was taking refuge in the cantina's ruins, Bane adding that he had an idea to draw the Daimyo out. ===Failed attack=== {{Quote|Our deal was that Tatooine was going to be a hospitable place to do business.''"
"''It is.''"
"''Half of my men were either shot or eaten by a rancor.|The boss and Mok Shaiz|}} As part of the Pyke boss's plan to take over Mos Espa, he made a deal with the leaders of the three ruling families to betray Fett and break a deal of neutrality they had made with the Daimyo. While soldiers from the three families turned on Fett's forces, Pyke forces advanced on the Sanctuary, and a battle eventually broke out. Unfortunately for the boss, half of his forces were killed in battle and were forced to retreat. Back at the Desert Survey Office, the Pyke spoke with Shaiz and the three family dons, informing them that his remaining forces were recalling to Mos Eisley for a withdrawal from Tatooine. Two of the family leaders angrily contested the Pyke boss as he had a deal with them, but the boss added that the deal required for Tatooine to be hospitable for the Pyke Syndicate's business, citing the Pykes' losses at the battle in Mos Espa when Shaiz argued that it was hospitable. [[File:AssassinationofTatooinePykes-BoBFCh7.png|thumb|right|300px|The Pyke's allies are gunned down]] The group was then [[Assassination of the Pyke Syndicate leaders|interrupted]] by the sound of blaster shooting outside, and the boss called to his door [[Pyke sentinel|guards]], drawing his [[blaster pistol]] when no response came. That was when blaster fire came from above, killing the three family leaders and the room's two Pyke guards. Shaiz was then snared by a [[grappling line]] which strangled him to [[death]]. Being the only one left alive, the Pyke shot above him and looked around, spotting a silhouette through a window. However, the attacker, Fett's [[assassin]], [[Fennec Shand]], sneaked behind the boss and stabbed him in the back with a knife, killing him. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|They no longer exist.''"
"''Are you sure?''"
"''Yes. We destroyed them ourselves.|The Pyke boss and Mok Shaiz discuss a Tusken tribe|}} [[File:Unidentified_Pyke_boss.png|thumb|left|200px|The Pyke Boss was both ruthless and pragmatic.]] A Pyke male, the boss had [[Color|light blue]] and beige skin with black [[eye]]s. When faced with a potentially deadly situation, the esteemed boss preferred to soothe out differences and find solutions that wouldn't disrupt his criminal enterprise, and he retaliated to the Tusken tribe by destroying them in order to protect his business. The boss chose to frame the Kintan Striders for the atrocity in order for Boba Fett to enact his revenge on the Nikto bikers rather than the Pyke Syndicate, all while appearing to welcome partnership with Fett. Although Mayor Mok Shaiz did not want open warfare in Mos Espa, the Pyke regardless authorized a bombing at the Sanctuary cantina, going on to apologize to the mayor for it after. After the Pyke Syndicate forces were bisected in their battle for the city, the boss decided to cut his losses and abandon Tatooine, seeing it as no longer hospitable for the syndicate. ==Equipment== The Pyke boss wore a blue robes with golden patterns as well as black [[glove]]s and trousers. He also wielded a [[blaster]] [[pistol]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Jamie-Pyke-boss.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jamie Alexander as the Pyke boss]] {{Quote|Such a blast to join @the_jamiealexander in portraying the Pyke Boss! (I did the voice, Jamie got to hold the blaster!)|Phil LaMarr, on Twitter|{{Twitter|phillamaar|status/1482112898411503622|Phil Lamarr|quote=So excited to be part of #BookofBobaFett! Have you seen episode 3? Such a blast to join @the_jamiealexander in portraying the Pyke Boss! (I did the voice, Jamie got to hold the blaster!)|archivedate=20220114221536}}}} The Pyke boss appeared in the flashbacks of "[[Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa]]," the third episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which released on [[Disney+]] on [[January 12]], [[2022]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-january-2022|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in January 2022}} Credited as "Pyke Boss" he was voiced by [[Phil LaMarr]], with [[Jamie Alexander]] being the performance artist for the character. ==Appearances== *[[Bounty Hunters 42|''Bounty Hunters'' 42]] *{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} *{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-book-of-boba-fett-cargo-hold-chapter-3|text=''The Book of Boba Fett'' Cargo Hold: "Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa"}} {{Po}} *{{SWYouTube|sUxcjRyXeHs|Stranger | The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+|sw_url=video/stranger-the-book-of-boba-fett}} *{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Book of Boba Fett|The Book of Boba Fett}} *{{SWYouTube|Sy5IsHN1XrA|Disney Gallery: The Book of Boba Fett | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-disney-gallery-star-wars-the-book-of-boba-fett}} *{{ToppsLivingSet|num=389|cardname=Pyke Boss|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/382562/cid/20796340/2023-Topps-Living-Star-Wars-389-Pyke-Boss}} *{{InsiderCite|217|A Certain Point of View}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|pyke-base|Pyke Base}} *{{Databank|pyke-boss|Pyke Boss}} *{{Databank|pyke-syndicate|Pyke Syndicate}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Jefe pyke no identificado |ja=パイクのボス |ka=პაიკი ბოისი }} [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Pyke Syndicate members]] [[Category:Pykes]]
